steps.note: Follow the value: four pages, four states, one run with the key.
With no key, the check goes quiet: the stderr warning counts the dropped values. A spec runs it without the config's key.
`manni meta fill docs/plain.md --fields owner --dry-run` encrypts the plain value, no model call.
A query UPDATE writes the marked property encrypted.
Reads do not decrypt: the SELECT shows what each page holds.
What a reviewer sees: `manni meta validate -f github`.
A value that decrypts under neither key stops the rotation, and it is named.

scaffolding: schemas/page.json is the page's schema (owner required, enum platform/billing, x-manni-encrypt). manni.config.yaml has collection `site`, that schema, and `encryptionKey:` set to manni's fixed test key, the key the page's ciphertexts were made under. docs/auth.md (platform), docs/bad-value.md (finance), docs/plain.md (plain `platform`) and docs/wrong-key.md (another key) carry the page's exact ciphertexts, from test/fixtures/encrypted. The no-key run needs the key out of the run: a spec drops it from the config or points `-c` at a copy without it. The manifest section (owners.yaml, stale.md, wrong.md) and the successful rotation are other setups the page doesn't give, so they are not expected.
